text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —It's Zenno Rob Roy, Zenno Rob Roy!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy— crosses the finish line in 
first place right now!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Claiming the Tenno Sho (Autumn)! The 
Japan Cup! And now conquering this Arima 
Kinen!!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Following T.M. Opera O, the second in 
history! She has just accomplished the 
monumental feat of the "Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown"!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Congraaaats!! Incredible, that was an 
incredible run! You showed amazing 
strength, Zenno Rob Roy!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Really, truly, congratulations!! Thank you 
for letting me witness such a historic 
moment...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...Ah, I have to remember this feeling.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Because right after this, I have to tell 
Trainer so they can write it down.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Right, let's see. "The cheering 
praises"... Um, uhhh, "envelop me like 
a"... "Rain"? "Storm"?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Last year—and now. I have been 
defeated—twice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"What needed to be done right now... You 
have done it. ...Haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Thank you... for your kind 
congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Because I was given—courage. —To be a 
"Hero".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
If a Heroâ is one whoâbestows 
something upon othersâ

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Their true identity is――unknown. 
Impossible――I can't say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Within my chest... something like a 
flickering light.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Stupid, don't cry, don't cry here! After 
all, this is finally, it's just, 
...aaagh!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the little hero finally teared up, 
Symboli Kris S gently shielded her behind 
her broad back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely no one would think it was pathetic. 
Yet, the surprisingly stubborn hero waited 
until the tears stopped before finally 
appearing before the audience—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
High, so high she thrust her fist into the 
air. As if holding aloft a hero's blade.
